title: security-eng-sync-notes-2026-03-18
content:
Date: 2026-03-18
Time: 09:00-09:45 PT
Location: Zoom / #security-eng
Purpose: Weekly security engineering sync - vuln triage, secrets findings, threat modeling updates and action tracking.

1) Quick updates / housekeeping
- Agenda reviewed. Added brief updates on SRE escalation playbook and upcoming compliance audit.
- Remind: rotate test harness keys for dedicated-staging by end of week (see action items).

2) Vulnerability triage
- CVE tracking: Dependency CVE-2026-0456 affecting internal request-router (transitive in req-router -> fast-conn v2.1.3). Severity: CVSS 7.8 (high). Status: confirmed reproduction in staging.
  - Decision: Patch first in staging, run regression tests; if stable, schedule canary to production on 2026-03-22.
  - Owner: Evan Miller. Jira: SEC-4321.
- Container image base (ubuntu:22.04) kernel patch advisory noted - infra to rebuild images with updated base next build window.
  - Owner: Luca Bianchi (release-eng). Target: 2026-03-19 image rebuild.
- Third-party model-converter tool flagged for insecure temp file handling (low/medium). We will add a workspace isolation wrapper and create a minimal repro test.
  - Owner: Priya Desai. PR queued: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/1234

3) Secrets detection and remediation
- git-secrets run (weekly): 12 new findings across repos; triaged down to 2 confirmed exposures in model-service tests (AWS STS creds in test fixtures).
  - Immediate action: credentials rotated and invalidated, keys removed from repo. Rotation ticket: SEC-4319.
  - Follow-up: add automated pre-commit hook in model-service repo, and enforce on CI for all repos with model-serving code.
  - Owner: Grace Li. Due: 2026-03-20.
- Discussion: introduce a secrets-review gating step for PRs touching ci/ and deploy/ directories. Decision: opt-in for this sprint, evaluate rollout next meeting.
- Vault / KMS: plan to accelerate secret engine onboarding for dedicated customers. Omar to draft onboarding checklist and KMS integration notes.
  - Owner: Omar Haddad. Deliverable: draft checklist on Confluence by 2026-03-25.

4) Threat modeling updates
- New component: model-pinning-service (handles customer pin requests and rollout policies). Initial threat model reviewed. Key risks identified:
  - Authorization bypass on pin creation (elevated risk). Mitigation: require cross-service auth check + signature verification.
  - Data exfil via misconfigured callbacks. Mitigation: restrict egress CIDR and validate callback domains against allowlist.
- Action: create security design doc, include sequence diagrams and allowed-data schema.
  - Owner: Priya Desai. Target review: 2026-03-24.
- Pen-test scope: add model-pinning-service and dedicated admin console to Q2 pen-test list. Coordinate with GRC.

5) Observability and telemetry for security events
- Request: add alert for suspicious token-creation rates from a single IP (possible credential stuffing). SRE to propose thresholds.
  - Owner: Evan Miller + SRE on-call.
- Logging: ensure request-router includes anonymized model_id and route metadata in security audit logs. Privacy check required.

6) Incidents & retro notes
- Minor escalation reported last week due to misrouted canary; root cause: rollout config mismatch between console and runtime. Action: add validation step in rollout API and improve rollout config docs.
  - Owner: Luca (runtime), Grace (console).

7) Action items (summary)
- Evan: Patch request-router for CVE-2026-0456 in staging, prepare canary plan (due 2026-03-20).
- Luca: Rebuild base images with security patches (due 2026-03-19).
- Priya: Fix model-converter temp file handling and prepare threat model doc for model-pinning-service (docs due 2026-03-24).
- Grace: Rotate and revoke leaked test creds, add pre-commit hook and CI enforcement (due 2026-03-20).
- Omar: Draft Vault/KMS onboarding checklist and KMS integration notes (due 2026-03-25).
- SRE: Propose suspicious token creation alert thresholds (due 2026-03-21).

8) Blockers & requests
- Need resources for focused secrets remediation sprint - small team (2 FTEs) for one week recommended. Grace to scope.
- Request from product: clarification of data retention for audit logs. Samira to sync with product-privacy next Tue.

9) Next meeting
- Weekly cadence maintained. Next sync: 2026-03-25 09:00 PT.

Notes captured by: Samira Khan
